title: Old Tokyo: Tsukiji breakfast · sumo morning · chanko · samurai swords · Hagoita-ichi · Hoppy Street · private omakase

stops.name: Ninja House
stops.plan: Out the door early and hungry: breakfast is the Tsukiji crawl.
stops.transport: Walk to Ochiai-minami-nagasaki, Toei Oedo line direct to Tsukijishijo (the 06:55), about 60 min door to door

stops.name: Tsukiji Outer Market breakfast crawl (Kitsuneya horumon-don + tamagoyaki)
stops.plan: Graze in pairs: tamagoyaki on a stick, grilled scallops and tuna, Kitsuneya's horumon-don at the counter in shifts; regroup at 08:30. Trade buyers get priority until 09:00, so keep out of their way.
stops.transport: Tokyo Metro Hibiya line Tsukiji → Ningyocho, then walk, about 32 min

stops.name: Arashio-beya
stops.plan: Morning keiko at a working sumo stable, if it is on: phone the stable the week before, as the winter tour is at Hasuda on Dec 16 and practice viewing is now a 俵の会 members' course. Fallback if there is no public practice: walk the Ryōgoku Kokugikan area (the arena, the wrestler hand-prints and statues around the station) before the museum and Chanko Kirishima.
stops.transport: Toei Shinjuku line Hamacho → Morishita, Toei Oedo line → Ryōgoku, about 33 min

stops.name: Edo-Tokyo Museum
stops.plan: The reopened museum next to the Kokugikan: the life-size Nihonbashi bridge and the Edo townscape models in a fast 40-minute loop before lunch.

stops.name: Chanko Kirishima
stops.plan: Booked 11:30 private room (個室) for 8: the sumo hot pot from former ōzeki Kirishima's house, right at opening.
stops.transport: JR Sobu local line Ryōgoku → Akihabara, JR Yamanote line → Uguisudani, then walk, about 32 min

stops.name: Tokyo National Museum (samurai swords & armor)
stops.plan: Straight to the Honkan sword and armour rooms: Japan's biggest samurai collection in 70 minutes, nothing else.
stops.transport: Walk through Ueno Park to Ameyoko, 15 min

stops.name: mita sneakers (Ameyoko)
stops.plan: The Ameyoko sneaker institution in the Ameyoko Center Building: exclusives and collabs; bring passports for tax-free.
stops.transport: Tokyo Metro Ginza line Ueno → Asakusa, then walk, about 20 min

stops.name: Sensō-ji + Hagoita-ichi (year-end battledore fair)
stops.plan: Up Nakamise to the main hall before it shuts at 17:00, then the Hagoita-ichi stalls as the lights come on at dusk: buy one and the stall claps you out.

stops.name: Asakusa Hoppy Street
stops.plan: Okamoto's terrace for 8: Hoppy and a couple of bowls of beef-tendon nikomi to share, but keep room for the omakase at 20:00.
stops.transport: Tokyo Metro Ginza line Asakusa → Kanda, JR Chuo line rapid → Shinjuku, JR Chuo-Sobu local line → Higashi-Nakano, then walk, about 52 min

stops.name: Sushi Kunimitsu
stops.plan: The headline: the private counter for the 8 of you, late seating (20:00 or 20:30, the TableCheck confirmation decides). Card required.
stops.transport: Walk to Higashi-Nakano, Toei Oedo line → Ochiai-minami-nagasaki, then walk, about 35 min

stops.name: Back at Ninja House
stops.plan: Early night by this group's standards: tomorrow is the big Friday.
